_comment: PrismML llama.cpp fork greedy references for the Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
GGUFs (PTQ1_0 and PQ2_0), recorded once from llama-server on the Metal
build of the fork at the commit below:
temperature 0, n_predict 48, n_probs 20, cache_prompt false, and
Each run names its file and prompt, the prompt token ids the fork saw
(no BOS: the Bonsai tokenizer has add_bos_token false), the 48 greedy
tokens, and per step the fork's top-20 [token, logprob] pairs. The
replay test teacher-forces 'tokens' through gmlx and compares its
logprobs on those top-20 entries; 'content' is the decoded text.
